title: BNPL Affordability Assessment Modeller
description: Model BNPL affordability assessment methodology options against FCA CONC 5, EU CCD2 Art. 18, and CFPB ability-to-repay requirements. Derives product risk tier from transaction value, repayment count, and APR. Scores methodology against per-framework requirements and outputs a proportionality analysis, gap table, and Markdown report. Scope: compliance methodology assessment only — not actual credit decisions.
scope_disclaimer: COMPLIANCE METHODOLOGY ASSESSMENT ONLY. This tool evaluates whether a BNPL provider's affordability assessment methodology meets regulatory minimum requirements. It does NOT make, model, or advise on individual consumer credit decisions.

product_value_tier.description: Typical transaction value range. Drives proportionality tier.

apr_tier.description: Product APR category: zero (0%), low (1-24%), high (25%+).

income_signal.description: Income verification method used in affordability assessment.

proportionality_status.description: Whether methodology depth is proportionate to product risk tier.

gap_rows.description: Missing and partial requirement items across all selected frameworks.

mcp_tool_definition.name: model_bnpl_affordability_methodology_compliance
mcp_tool_definition.description: Assess whether a BNPL provider's affordability assessment methodology meets FCA CONC 5, EU CCD2 Art. 18, and CFPB ability-to-repay requirements. Derives product risk tier and checks methodology proportionality. Returns per-framework compliance scores (0-100), proportionality verdict, and a gap table with remediation actions. Scope: compliance methodology assessment only — not individual credit decisions.

risk_tier_matrix.description: Proportionality tier derived by summing dimension scores: value (0-3) + repayments (0-2) + APR (0-2). Total 0-1=low, 2-4=medium, 5+=high.

scoring_methodology: Requirements scored: 1.0 (met), 0.5 (partially met — income/bureau depth insufficient for risk tier), 0.0 (not met). MUST items weight 1.5; SHOULD items weight 0.75. Score = weighted sum / weighted max × 100. Tiers: >=80 Compliant, 60-79 Adequate, 40-59 Needs Improvement, <40 Non-Compliant.
notes: Client-side. Zero PII. Gold accent (--gold). Compliance methodology assessment only — not credit decisions. Explicit scope disclaimer is a mandatory UI element.
